text:
kat: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the v2.4.1 deploy to us-west now, feature flag toggles included. target window 23:00-00:30 PST. planning a stepwise enable for 'llm-route-v3' across cohorts. @deploy-bot queueing the job.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job #D-98723 queued by kat for 23:00 PST. Releases: v2.4.1 (routing + batching fixes). Will perform flag shifts as: initial 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100% with 10m holdpoints.

sam: copying — what's the rollback trigger set?

kat: Rollback triggers: 5m error rate >1.5x baseline OR p95 latency >350ms OR user-facing failures (>=0.5% of requests returning 5xx). If any trigger fires, we pin traffic back to v2.4.0 and disable flag.

alex: Add cost-surge guard: abort ramp if token throughput jumps >2x projected for the cohort. We had a billing surprise last month.

maria: noted. I'll watch infra metrics and have autoscale knobs ready. ops-bot, can you mute non-critical alerts for this window? :slightly_smiling_face:

ops-bot: Muting alert group "devops-noise" for 45m starting 23:00 PST. Critical path alerts remain enabled.

kat: Ramp plan pasted here for clarity:
```
step 1: enable llm-route-v3 for cohort:internal-dev (3%) - hold 10m
step 2: enable for cohort:beta-users (15%) - hold 10m
step 3: enable for cohort:regional-1 (40%) - hold 10m
step 4: enable for cohort:regional-2 (80%) - hold 10m
step 5: full enable (100%) - monitor 30m
backout: set llm-route-v3=false for all cohorts; pin service-routing to v2.4.0
```

sam: Who's owning the decision at each holdpoint?

kat: I'll own first two holds. alex picks up regional stages. If anything odd, @maria + @jing will triage infra. Final call handover to sam for full enable.

jing: quick note — we'll also flip cache-ttl down to 30s during steps 3/4 to avoid stale KV divergence. I'll run the rollout script after each cohort flip: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh llm-route-v3 <cohort>`

deploy-bot: Executing step 1 in 30s: `scripts/rollout_toggle.sh llm-route-v3 internal-dev true` (dry-run false). Will report completion + telemetry tags.

alex: During step 3, if model latency p50 increases >120ms from baseline, throttle the ramp and call for a QA snapshot. Do not proceed without triage.

maria: I'm subscribed to latency/error dashboards. Will post short status at 5/10 minute marks.

sam: Good. Also adding a release-note blurb for ops and support channels: "v2.4.1: routing + batching; experimental llm-route-v3 enabled via staged cohorts; rollback criteria in eng-releases thread." Anyone object?

kat: sounds good. No objections. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Step 1 completed at 23:00:35 — llm-route-v3 enabled for internal-dev (3%). Telemetry tags attached: deploy_id=D-98723 step=1 cohort=internal-dev

maria: metrics look clean at +5m — error rate within baseline, p50 latency +8ms. Moving to step 2 in 2m.

kat: proceeding. deploy-bot, start step 2 when ready.

deploy-bot: Step 2 started at 23:12:10 — enabling cohort beta-users (15%). Will hold 10m.

maria: at +4m for step 2 — p95 latency spike to 220ms for a short window (1m), recovered. monitoring continues.

alex: keep a close eye — that spike looked correlated with a specific shard. If repeats, we'll pause and roll back that shard only.

kat: If we need to abort, plan is: `deploy-bot abort D-98723 && scripts/pin_version.sh service-routing v2.4.0` and disable flag for cohorts.

sam: thumbs for the emergency command. Also documented in runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window ends 00:30 PST. All staged ops please wrap by then.

kat: thanks team. Will post final status after full enable or rollback.

maria: currently green at final check +10m after step 2. Ready for regional steps.

jing: running step 3 now.

(End of thread)
